prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production mobile game HUD Energy symbol mother
Input images: Image 1 is the Passed Stars HUD icon scale reference; Image 2 is the Passed Lv/EXP HUD material and visual-weight reference; Image 3 is the rejected old Energy symbol and must only inform the leaf/sprout meaning, not its orange glossy styling.
Primary request: Create one isolated tiny Looper vitality symbol: a short, plump two-leaf sprout carved/painted as a quiet inlay for the existing Passed cream-and-wood Global HUD family. The symbol should be simple enough to remain readable at about 20–24 px. Use one rounded stem and two soft leaves, with a subtle warm-cream center highlight.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background; only the isolated symbol.
Style/medium: cute stylized 2.5D hand-painted game object, large clean shapes, minimal detail, very soft depth.
Composition/framing: centered, front-facing, compact near-square silhouette, generous transparent margin.
Color palette: muted moss green, pale sprout green, warm cream highlight, very small walnut shadow.
Materials/textures: softly painted wood/leaf inlay; restrained texture; matte, not glossy.
Constraints: no text, no numbers, no frame, no panel, no circle socket, no bar, no amber orb; match the low visual weight and subdued saturation of the Passed HUD references; transparent RGBA.
Avoid: orange, red, neon, lightning bolt, battery, mana, resource bar, coin, badge, photoreal leaf, glossy jewel, high contrast, thick dark outline, black background.
